profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere is a California-based enterprise software company founded in 2003. Its website describes it as the number one provider of agentic automation, and it positions its platform as combining artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and agentic process automation to handle mission-critical enterprise workflows. The company offers a Cloud Community Edition for free access to its automation tools, and it maintains a global partner network for deployment support.

The company's core product is an intelligent automation platform that includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault for security. The site highlights the Mozart Orchestrator as the mechanism for coordinating AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers into end-to-end workflows. Use cases described on the site include IT service management, where the platform is said to support employee self-service, reduce IT service desk workload, and apply AIOps for incident prediction.

The held facts show Automation Anywhere has 181 legal exposure entries in California, which is consistent with its headquarters state, though no specific litigation cases are on record in the data. The company holds a tracked presence on theworldofai.org with its profile verified as of August 2026.
